name: Curious
description: Drawn to unfamiliar things and the questions they raise.

name: Patient
description: Comfortable taking time to watch, practise, and understand.

name: Resourceful
description: Looks for useful possibilities in the materials close at hand.

name: Cautious
description: Prefers to understand a risk before stepping into it.

name: Generous
description: Finds meaning in sharing knowledge, attention, and what can be spared.

name: Independent
description: Values finding a way forward through personal judgment and effort.

name: Observant
description: Tends to notice small changes in people and surroundings.

name: Steadfast
description: Holds to commitments even when progress is slow.

name: Inventive
description: Enjoys imagining new uses for familiar things.

name: Sociable
description: Welcomes conversation and the chance to know another person.

name: Reflective
description: Returns to past experiences to consider what they might mean.

name: Adventurous
description: Feels the pull of unexplored places and untried possibilities.
